name: 4-F-5-MeO-pyr-T
summary: 4-F-5-MeO-pyr-T, also known as 4-fluoro-5-methoxy-N,N-pyrrolidinyltryptamine, is a serotonin 5-HT1A receptor agonist of the tryptamine and pyrrolidinylethylindole families. It is a derivative of pyr-T and 5-MeO-DMT.

pharmacology.text: 4-F-5-MeO-pyr-T acts as a highly potent and selective serotonin 5-HT1A receptor full agonist. It shows about 813-fold selectivity in activating this receptor over the related serotonin 5-HT2A receptor. The drug shows little activity at other serotonin receptors besides the serotonin 5-HT1A receptor and little activity at the serotonin transporter (SERT) or other monoamine transporters (MATs).
